name: FINTRX
description:
The FINTRX MCP Server connects Claude to FINTRX, giving you direct access to the industry’s most expansive and up-to-date data on registered investment advisors, broker-dealers, wealth teams, and family offices.

With FINTRX connected, you can search and analyze intelligence across 850,000+ firm and contact records, including 45,000+ RIAs and broker-dealers and 4,500+ family offices. Identify key decision-makers, analyze ETF and portfolio holdings, uncover relationship signals, and build high-conviction prospect lists — all through natural language.

Whether you’re distributing funds, raising capital, recruiting advisors, or identifying M&A opportunities, FINTRX turns data into actionable intelligence directly inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FINTRX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FINTRX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aia.fintrx.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FINTRX MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FINTRX lists 44 MCP tools, including fintrx_get_family_office_aum_accounts, fintrx_get_family_office_contacts, fintrx_get_family_office_direct_investments, fintrx_get_family_office_news, fintrx_get_family_office_overview, fintrx_get_family_office_real_estate_investments, fintrx_get_family_office_related_entities, fintrx_get_filter_catalog, fintrx_get_fo_contact_overview, fintrx_get_list_composition, fintrx_get_list_records, and fintrx_get_list_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FINTRX?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FINTRX in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
FINTRX requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FINTRX is developed by FINTRX Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
